sys_user_registration_config.description:
Please fill out all fields on the form.

Once submitted, background logic will process the information to create a new user account with the appropriate basic access for the SV Public Demo Portal.

Please watch your email for instructions.

 

CLICK FOR DETAILS (NERD STUFF)

The details herein are dependent on the configurations represented on the User Registration Configuration record.

BOLD text indicates fields on the configuration record while ITALICIZED text indicates other tables or records.

  1. The record producer writes to the Registration table
  2. Users are redirected to Post registration redirect page
  3. User Registration Request Business Rules kick off to:
    1. Update values in the registration record before insert
    2. Trigger the User verification flow
      1. This sends an email with an activation link.
  4. Once the activation link in the email is accessed by the user:
    1. A successful response from the External User Onboarding API sends the user to the Activation success page
    2. The pending Registration table request is set to Processed
    3. A User Registration Request Business Rule kicks off to:
      1. Create a record in the Activation table
    4. Transform maps associated with the Activation table run to:
      1. Create a User [sys_user] record
      2. Create a registration user profile in the User table
    5. User table Business Rules kick off to:
      1. Trigger the User onboarding flow which performs a password reset and emails reset instructions for the user
      2. Assign the snc_external role to the user

NOTES:

As this particular registration was built as part of a scoped application:

  • OOTB instances of GlideRecord .queryNoDomain(), GlideAggregate .addOrCondition(), and new JSON() needed to be amended so I ended up copying the OOTB flows to make the necessary changes.
  • OOTB event email.verification.for.external.users in the Global scope is inaccessible so a scoped event needed to be created.
    • This resulted in copying the OOTB notification associated with the event for the newly scoped event.
  • The OOTB default Password Reset Process is not being used so I had to update the hard-coded URL pointing to that.
  • Although this makes an External user, a custom copy of the onboarding flow adds the necessary permissions for SV Public Demo Portal access.

Additional customization:

  • I never intended for an email address to be used to log in so I had to update the scripted field map that was used in creating the user_name on the sys_user record. The logic accounts for duplication by appending a number in sequence as well as for user_name max length through a method of re-querying the sys_user table to determine the next valid user_name to use.

Undisturbed functionality:

  • Existing users will get a notification for a password reset instead of an activation email.
  • Users are routed to the Activation error page if the activation fails.
